title: "Plugin: updater-composer"

<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Updates the `version` field in `composer.json` for PHP projects when explicitly opted in. Because Composer 2.x typically derives package versions from Git tags, this plugin leaves `composer.json` untouched by default unless `update_version_field: "true"` is configured.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/updater-composer
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/updater-composer:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/updater-composer:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/updater-composer/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/updater-composer
    phase: pre-tag
    args:
      file: composer.json
      update_version_field: "true"
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_FILE` | no | `composer.json` | Path to the Composer manifest to update. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_COMPOSER_FILE` | no | `—` | Alias for `SEMREL_PLUGIN_FILE` when a Composer-specific variable name is preferred. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_UPDATE_VERSION_FIELD` | no | `false` | When `true`, updates or inserts the `version` field in `composer.json`. |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

## Behavior

By default the plugin is a safe no-op and logs why it did not modify `composer.json`. When `SEMREL_PLUGIN_UPDATE_VERSION_FIELD=true`, it strips any leading `v` from the release version, writes the bare SemVer string to `composer.json`, and preserves existing key ordering and formatting.
